source_baseline.working_tree_at_artwork_start: Existing uncommitted workflow documentation; all previous artwork preserved during F4-F6

scope: Fascist follow-up F4-F6:12 focuses+8 spirits;no decisions or categories
method: Permitted local PNG components, new per-content composition and isolated background recoloring. No AI generation, new illustration or download.
permission: CREDITS.txt declares contributor consent and all free to use; applies only to selected pack files, not entire contributing mods. No MIT/CC license inferred.

palette.mask_rule: A > 0 and R-G > 6 and R-B > 3 and B-G >= -4
palette.shading: pow((0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B)/60,0.9), clamp rounded reference RGB times shade; original alpha
palette.scope: Background alone; central source pieces and metallic border unfiltered
